facts.fact: Guinea's state digitalisation agency ANDE, backed by the World Bank-funded WARDIP programme, held a workshop on 2026-09-23 to validate the feasibility study for a National Digital Academy offering short certified courses, aimed first at civil servants, and the project moves to operationalisation.
